global_issues: Seed sets required=true for every field of every product, so conditional fields (motor, remote channel, divider position, French door, etc.) block every quote. Needs a required_when rule per field.
Most option fields are seeded input_kind=typed with no choice list; only ~255 field/product pairs have buttons in quote_catalog_field_choice.
Onyx depends_on is empty for every field even though the Onyx schema has if/then rules by material, divider rail, split tilt rod and shutter type.

Field-name mismatches handled by quote_sequence_field_alias (102 rows): color_code->fabric_color_code, color_name->fabric_color_name, collection->fabric_collection/fabric_color_collection, control_type->lift_system, valance_fascia_type->valance/roller_top_treatment/top_treatment_class, panel_configuration->panel_config, room_location->room_name. One schema field mapping to 2-3 saved keys is a conflict risk.
PDF/DOCX order packets in the repo could not be read through the GitHub connector (binary); their checkbox option lists were not compared.

Norman portal header (doc: roller order: dealer ship-to company/contact/address/phone (state, ZIP, country structured)
Onyx portal header (schema): portal date check + ship-via check (account values, verify visually)
